ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious GUP Usage
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the Notepad++ updater in a suspicious directory, which is often used in DLL side-loading attacks

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\GUP\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Notepad\\+\\+\\\\updater\\\\GUP\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Notepad\\+\\+\\\\updater\\\\GUP\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Notepad\\+\\+\\\\updater\\\\GUP\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\Notepad\\+\\+\\\\updater\\\\GUP\\\.exe$"))))
